sections.text:
The SU91 relay is a solid state relay. The relay detects the fault on the
 busbar, and trips all the breakers connected to the bus. The relay requires current inputs from all circuits connected to the bus.
 All the current transformers used in busbar relay should have the same ratio
 and they should be on the full winding with a minimum knee point. The
 secondary circuits of the current transformer are connected together (in
 parallel) in CT Junction box the busbar differential protection is based on
 differential voltage measurement.

The output of the SU91 busbar differential relay initiates two LOR Lokout
 relay (86B) the output of these two lokout relay are used to trip and block
 all circuit breakers connected to the bus and to initiate the station
 annunciator and sequence events recorder. The trip and block contacts of the lockout relay are provided with test
 switches to remove the output circuits during testing.

The first draft 
initialed and tested by eng. Adel AbdEl Fataah at Nag Hmady, 
 approved by general director of Quality eng. Sameer Mohamed Atta.
